facts.text: PyAPT controls Thorlabs APT hardware from Python through APT.dll and APT.lib
The README tells the user to obtain the x86 or x64 APT.dll and APT.lib and to install the Thorlabs APT software
The README lists Thorlabs APT controllers including the BSC001, TDC001, LTSXXX and BBD10X
The module imports ctypes.windll and uses Python 2 print statements, so it is Windows-only and does not parse as Python 3
The constructor loads APT.dll into self.aptdll, calls EnableEventDlg(True) and APTInit, and keeps the serial number as a c_long
initializeHardwareDevice calls InitHWDevice(serial) and sets Connected only when it returns zero
getPos calls MOT_GetPosition and refuses to read when the object is not Connected
mRel calls MOT_MoveRelativeEx with the wait flag True, and mAbs calls MOT_MoveAbsoluteEx with the wait flag True
go_home calls MOT_MoveHome with the serial number; the upstream call passes no other argument
getVelocityParameters reads MOT_GetVelParams and setVelocityParameters writes MOT_SetVelParams
getVelocityParameterLimits reads the controller's maximum acceleration and maximum velocity at run time through MOT_GetVelParamLimits
getStageAxisInformation returns the minimum position, maximum position, unit code and pitch from MOT_GetStageAxisInfo
The stage unit code is 1 for millimetres and 2 for degrees
The vendor APT client calls MOT_StopProfiled from its StopProfiled button handler
MOT_MoveHome, MOT_MoveRelativeEx and MOT_MoveAbsoluteEx take the serial number and a wait flag
cleanUpAPT calls APTCleanUp and sets Connected to False

operator_required.name: position
operator_required.reason: the travel range belongs to the installed stage: getStageAxisInformation reads the minimum and maximum from the controller at run time (PyAPT/PyAPT.py:114-121) and no text file of the clone states a fixed range; the operator supplies the range in the stage unit

operator_required.name: acceleration
operator_required.reason: the maximum acceleration belongs to the installed stage: getVelocityParameterLimits reads the controller's own limit at run time (PyAPT/PyAPT.py:167-172) and no text file of the clone states a fixed number; the operator supplies the ceiling in the stage unit per second squared

operator_required.name: maximum_velocity
operator_required.reason: the maximum velocity belongs to the installed stage: getVelocityParameterLimits reads the controller's own limit at run time (PyAPT/PyAPT.py:167-172) and no text file of the clone states a fixed number; the operator supplies the ceiling in the stage unit per second

operator_required.name: move_relative
operator_required.reason: a relative move is bounded by the current position and the travel range of the installed stage, which the clone reads from the controller at run time (PyAPT/PyAPT.py:114-121); the operator supplies the distance range in the stage unit

safe_state.description: stage motion stopped with the native APT profiled stop (MOT_StopProfiled)
